_howto: Bi-weekly Gen 2 PETS update lives here (the creature sets have their own file, gen2-progress.json). Per set: 'done' = stages fully completed (1 Direction, 2 Concepts, 3 Redraw, 4 Final art, 5 In game), 'active' = being worked right now (shows the next stage as in-progress), optional 'status':'next' shows an 'Up next' chip on a queued set. 'note' is shown verbatim on the card and is the ONLY place this board states what's happening: it carries no 'next two weeks' or 'what's slowing this down' summary card, both were removed on purpose, so don't add a 'focus' or 'blocker' field back. 'updated' is the announcement date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional translations per entry: "i18n": { "pt": { "note": "…" } }.

sets.note: Finished, from the grumpy Salmon to the tiny Tako Sausage. Now they go into the game and get tested before they reach you.

pt.note: Prontos, do Salmon rabugento ao pequeno Tako Sausage. Agora eles entram no jogo e são testados antes de chegar até você.

es.note: Terminados, desde el gruñón Salmon hasta el diminuto Tako Sausage. Ahora entran al juego y se prueban antes de llegar a ti.

fr.note: Terminés, du Salmon grincheux au minuscule Tako Sausage. Maintenant, ils entrent dans le jeu et sont testés avant de vous arriver.

de.note: Fertig, vom mürrischen Salmon bis zur winzigen Tako Sausage. Jetzt kommen sie ins Spiel und werden getestet, bevor sie bei dir ankommen.

tr.note: Bitti, huysuz Salmon'dan minik Tako Sausage'e kadar. Şimdi oyuna ekleniyor ve sana ulaşmadan önce test ediliyor.
